How to Host Your App, API, and Database on One Server

Quick thread 🧵
Running the full stack on one server means your app reaches its database over the machine's local network, in under a millisecond, instead of a round trip across the internet to a hosted service.
You get one bill, one thing to back up, one place to debug, and a database that never has to face the public internet.
Split things apart later, deliberately, when real scale or separate teams make you.
For most apps, one box is the right default, not a compromise.
